Name: Shemaiah, Man of God
Summary: Shemaiah the man of God came to Rehoboam as Judah marched to fight Israel and said, You shall not go up nor fight your brethren, for this thing is from me; and the army turned back.
KeyStory: Shemaiah stops Rehoboam's war against Israel.
LifeLesson: Sometimes the bravest word a prophet speaks is 'do not fight your brothers.'
